value.rationale: The precise experimental pair is natural: exchange which boundary reflects and which absorbs while keeping the same interior diffusion. Complete two-profile compatibility characterizes which candidate data can come from any smooth Itô diffusion, recovers two arbitrary unknown coefficient functions and the stationary density without particle-position sampling, and gives an explicit sharp C^1 stability limit. One-profile failure is demonstrated by an infinite-dimensional physical family. The result is structural and complete rather than a parameter table or routine case of known fixed-D inversion.
